source_authority: National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), an autonomous body established by UGC
source_title: NAAC Basic Accreditation Portal / public accreditation status lookup
scope: Institution-level higher-education accreditation status/grade and cycle information. The India.gov discovery entry says accredited and re-accredited institution lists under the new methodology are available; NAAC remains the data authority.
scope_caveats: The official portal is dynamic and no stable public bulk endpoint or complete export was verified in this check.
An accredited-only roster is not a complete HEI universe; absence must be unknown, not a negative accreditation result.
Preserve cycle/methodology, grade/score, accreditation date and validity; do not show expired status as current.
NAAC institutional accreditation is distinct from programme accreditation and from NIRF ranking.
acquisition_caveat: The NAAC home/portal did not expose a complete downloadable status roster through the available browser. The India.gov URL is only a discovery reference and is not used as NAAC data. No grades were acquired or assigned.
